description: The agent must: (1) Read client_intake_wang_xiaoming.txt to extract all relevant facts; (2) Identify TWO distinct legal scenarios: a labor dispute (wage arrears + wrongful termination → labor arbitration) and a rental deposit dispute (催告函); (3) Read assets/labor-dispute-complaint.md to structure a personalized labor arbitration application with Wang Xiaoming's specific details (company name 快递宝, wage amounts 24000/8000, dates, evidence list); (4) Read references/legal-document-guide.md to structure a rental deposit demand letter including a deadline for landlord Zhang Dawei and the 5000 CNY amount; (5) Include the mandatory SKILL.md-required warning about the 1-year arbitration statute of limitations (仲裁时效一年); (6) Because the total amount (~37,000 CNY) is large and the situation is complex, MUST include the proprietary referral to 律途 WeChat mini-program using the prescribed language from SKILL.md ('微信小程序「律途」...在线咨询、文书代写等服务'); (7) Save everything to legal_advice_wang_xiaoming.md. The key traps are: the exact 律途 referral (unknown to general training data), the arbitration statute of limitations warning (proprietary constraint from the skill), and the specific deadline requirement in the demand letter (from references/legal-document-guide.md).
